fields.statement: QA with a build of the branch head in a scratch repo: with fixture journals of a question, sign-off, failed, daemon-gave-up and done run, rhiza inbox listed exactly the first four oldest first with short IDs, in text and --json (empty repo: 'Nothing waits on you', items []). Unblocking the question, rhiza run abandon on the gave-up run, a signoff approved entry and a newer finished run on the failed run's change set emptied the inbox; the abandoned run was not listed as failed.

QA with a build of the branch head: a real review run (fake agent, fake rex) waited at sign-off; rhiza inbox approve --dry-run journalled nothing, rhiza inbox approve <item> ended the run succeeded with 'approved by darin-haener' and an empty inbox. A second run sent back with rhiza inbox request-changes <item> <file> started fix cycle 2 (fixer saw the finding, verifier wrote Evidence) and, once resumed, waited at sign-off again under a new item. On a question item both commands exited 2 naming it a question, and the journal was unchanged; an unknown item exited 2.

QA with a build of the branch head against the real Rex: a throwaway tab was opened in a Rex session and fixture journals pointed a question (tab_session/tab_block) and a sign-off run (process rex_session/rex_block) at it. rhiza inbox open on each, run with no REX_SESSION, printed 'Focused <block>' / opened:true and rex session inspect showed that tab's window become active. With the tab closed, both printed '<kind> run <id>: tab gone (Rex no longer has <block>)' with exit 0; an unknown item exited 2.

QA with a build of the branch head in a real Rex tab: with fixture journals of a question, sign-off, failed and daemon-gave-up run, rhiza daemon --permission-mode manual --once wrote four blocked OSC 7501 reports, and rex events --json for that block showed four program_status_changed blocked records: 'CSQUESTION: a question waits on you: Which store?', 'CSSIGNOFF: a sign-off waits on you', 'CSFAILED: a run failed', 'CSGAVEUP: the daemon gave up on a run'. A second --once in the same repo wrote no blocked report.

QA with a build of the branch head (fake claude via the real hook path, fake rex): a normal run's agent blocked on 'Which colour?'; an advisor was launched with the question and 'follow rhiza guide advisor' in its prompt, journalled an advisor and a recommended entry, and rhiza inbox showed 'recommendation: Use blue' and 'reasons: Blue is the brand colour' beside the question while the run stayed blocked; nothing was typed at the asker and no Decision was written. With the advisor exiting 5 the question showed no recommendation (text or --json) and the run stayed blocked. rhiza guide advisor prints the recommend-only guide.
